canonical_capture_hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with canonical_capture_hash omitted
capture_limitations: Chat transport bytes are unavailable; the complete structured proposal is preserved semantically in submitted_packet.

purpose.summary: Guarantee that every inducted contribution remains represented and discoverable throughout its governed lifecycle.
motivation: The governed textbook functions as both a publishable document and an active research notebook.
No inducted contribution shall become undiscoverable because of synchronization, projection, review, or publication decisions.
Governance shall distinguish omission by design from omission by failure.

accepted_findings: Preservation is separated from review and promotion.
Synchronization between Intake, Queue, Registry, and downstream projections is incomplete.
Projection completeness cannot presently be demonstrated.

new_principles.title: Induction Persistence
new_principles.statement: Every inducted contribution shall possess at least one governed representation throughout its lifecycle.

new_principles.title: Representation Traceability
new_principles.statement: Every governed representation shall retain an explicit trace to its preserved source.

new_principles.title: No Silent Omission
new_principles.statement: No inducted contribution may disappear from all governed representations without an explicit governed disposition.

new_invariants.statement: Every inducted contribution has one or more governed representations.
Every representation references exactly one preserved induction source.
Every omission requires an explicit disposition record.
Review status shall never erase preservation.
Promotion status shall never determine existence.

validation_gates.rule: Every inducted contribution must map to one or more governed representations.
If an inducted contribution is absent from a representation, an explicit disposition record shall exist.
Analysis Intake, Global Queue, Canonical Registry, and Representation Ledger shall reconcile every induction identifier before downstream projections are marked current.
Every governed representation shall be verifiably reachable from its preserved induction source.

representation_lifecycle.name: REPRESENTATION
representation_lifecycle.requirement: At least one governed representation created.

governance_constraints: Review shall not remove an inducted contribution.
Promotion shall not determine representation existence.
Synchronization failure shall not remove representation.
Every representation remains traceable to first-contact preservation.
acceptance_criteria: Every inducted contribution has at least one governed representation.
No inducted contribution has a NULL destination.
Synchronization across Intake, Queue, Registry, and Representation Ledger succeeds.
non_goals: Does not redefine review or promotion.
Does not require every contribution to appear in the primary narrative.
Does not alter existing preservation guarantees.

expected_effect.before: An inducted contribution could become effectively undiscoverable if omitted from downstream representations or synchronization failed.
expected_effect.after: Every inducted contribution remains permanently represented somewhere within the governed corpus with explicit traceability and disposition.
